---
applyTo: 'src/components/**'
---

Avoid unnecessary secondary labels and descriptions. Let the layout do the explaining.

- One label per thing. No subtitle that restates a title, no caption under a self-evident control, no heading over a single group.
- No hint that names the obvious gesture ("Click to select").
- Group, align and order instead of explaining. If a screen needs a paragraph of help, fix the layout.
- Words stay for what the layout cannot show: an icon-only button's tooltip and `aria-label`, an irreversible action, a cost, an empty state.

Full convention: `.agents/skills/let-layout-explain/SKILL.md`.
